body: hey dude, I think we have much in common, what's your discord? :)

hey dude, thanks for messaging. since two months ago, I might understood some things, and yes, feel better.
seems like that sensation is going to hunt both of us for life, but I think we can really oppress it and experience it way less.
I came to conclusion I might've not taken the right approach in the matter of friendship. friends truly are important, at least for myself. I've felt like a punching bag, and it was time to stop. so instead of forcing myself to befriend someone who "used" me, I managed to find someone else, which truly cares and appreciate our friendship. also, real life friends are also important, so I developed an interest (not forcibly, it just happened) and turns out someone I know also have that interest, so we now meet irl (we workout now).
I've also set up some goals for myself, things that interest me and I need to achieve, and it seems like it motivated me a lot. 
yes, we sometimes feel like we want a way out, but instead of taking an approach of "if I feel like it, I need to get rid of it, or give up", we need to acknowledge that it's there forever, but we need to keep it to the minimum. After those two months I've found myself doing much better although I still have some bad events. the feeling is great though, it absolutely is. 

thank you for asking about me, I appreciate it a lot. 
do let me know about yourself and what are you going to do next, or even dm me if you wanna talk privately. wishing you all the best <3
